ModMetaData.name: GlyphFix
ModMetaData.author: SleepSheep
ModMetaData.description: Repairs four rendering defects of the Waylith Android port: blank build-menu icons (uiIcon resolved to BadTex through an unrenderable CutoutComplexUI material); the empty gizmo box beside Draft (Misc/GrayscaleGUI is not registered in this port, so disabled-command icons were drawn through the default shader); masked DLC art that drew blank or drew its own mask (double-extension content keys broke every mask lookup, and let masks into Graphic_Collection's variant list); and noisy mod textures (every non-official-ui texture was sampled with MaxLod 1000 over mip levels this port never fills, so the sampler is forced to mip 0). Steady-state cost 16.7 ns per patched call.
